crossRefs.note: Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve Yahweh…
The Egyptians were urgent with the people, to send them out of the land in haste, for they said, “We are all dead men.”
They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.
She said to the men, “I know that Yahweh has given you the land, and that the fear of you has fallen upon us, and that…

people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.
